one_line: Early 17th‑century king of Manipur, linked with markets, coinage, brick works, and frontier conflicts.

appearance.age_look: Appears in his late 30s, lean but strong, with the poised build of a cavalry-trained ruler.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, warm medium-brown complexion, sharp dark-brown eyes under slightly arched brows, a neatly trimmed short moustache and light goatee; default expression calm and observant, with a hint of stern focus.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair gathered into a low knot at the back of the head, wrapped with a deep maroon cloth band like a simple turban strip that leaves the top of the head mostly exposed, a few controlled strands framing the temples.
appearance.costume: A knee-length white cotton pheijom-style wrap lower garment (dhoti-like, pleated in front, wrapped firmly around the waist) paired with a fitted, long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic that reaches mid-thigh with a simple round neck; over this, a soft handwoven shawl in muted cream with a broad deep-red border and thin black stripes (inspired by traditional phanek/pheijom borders) is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and under the right arm like a royal angavastram; at the waist, a narrow dark-red woven belt secures the wrap with a small, functional metal clasp; simple leather sandals on the feet; minimal jewellery: a single thin gold torque-like neck ornament close to the collarbone and small plain gold ear studs; no fantasy armour, only a discreet reinforced leather bracer on his left forearm suggesting practical battlefield use.
appearance.signature: A straight, slightly curved single-edged sword based on a Manipuri-style blade, about forearm length, with a plain iron blade, a simple wooden hilt wrapped in dark-brown leather, and no oversized guard, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard hanging from his left hip.

ref_desc: King Senbi Khagemba is a late-30s lean Meitei ruler with medium-brown skin, short moustache, black hair in a low knot wrapped with a maroon band, wearing a white pheijom wrap, off-white tunic, cream shawl with deep-red borders, simple torque and leather sandals, and carrying a plain leather-hilted Manipuri sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of King Senbi Khagemba as a dignified early 17th-century Meitei ruler: a lean late-30s man with medium-brown skin, an oval face, sharp dark-brown eyes, high cheekbones, a straight nose, a neatly trimmed short moustache and light goatee, and straight black hair tied in a low knot at the back, wrapped with a deep maroon cloth band, with a few strands framing his temples. He wears a knee-length white cotton pheijom-style wrap firmly around his waist, a fitted long-sleeved off-white cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh, and a cream handwoven shawl with a broad deep-red border and thin black stripes draped from his left shoulder across the chest and under his right arm like a royal angavastram. A narrow dark-red woven belt with a small functional metal clasp secures the wrap at his waist. His feet are in simple leather sandals, and he has minimal jewellery: a thin gold torque-like neck ornament and small plain gold ear studs. Add a subtle reinforced leather bracer on his left forearm to hint at battlefield use, but no heavy armour. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a straight, slightly curved single-edged Manipuri-style sword with a plain iron blade, a simple dark-brown leather-wrapped wooden hilt, and a brown leather scabbard. Use a restrained palette of white, cream, deep red, dark brown, and black, and present him in front, side, and three-quarter views to clearly show face, hair, costume details, and sword placement in a clean, historically grounded anime style.
